scope: Build time of the compiler and Blot compile speed: Goose port (dev -O0 and release -O2) against the Zig compiler (native backend -Dllvm=false and LLVM release). Single runs on a shared 16-core machine (load 7-17 from other sessions' jobs); ratios between runs taken back to back are more reliable than absolute times.

goose_checker_once.what: upstream d5ae5bb + series 01-29, GOOSE_PGO=1 build.sh (includes a training emit)

zig_native_cold.command: zig build install -Doptimize=fast -Dllvm=false with fresh ZIG_LOCAL_CACHE_DIR and ZIG_GLOBAL_CACHE_DIR

building_the_compiler.note: The Goose checker emit was ~490 s before PR #47 and is 344 s here under heavier load.

compiling_blot.method: Ink test modules through build-project (CLI); Gdev Main through scripts/integration/build_gdev.ts (project server, codegen 1 / frontend 4 workers). Every compiler produced byte-identical Wasm for every input.
